mcqs.question: What is the primary objective of Google's Project Suncatcher?
options: To assess the feasibility of AI computing infrastructure in space
To conduct the first orbital test on October 1, 2026
To test Google's Tensor Processing Units in the space environment
To speed up tensor and matrix computations in artificial intelligence and machine learning
mcqs.explanation: Google's Project Suncatcher examines the feasibility of establishing AI computing infrastructure in space. The October 1, 2026 orbital test and testing of Google's Tensor Processing Units are associated with the project, while speeding up tensor and matrix computations describes the function of a TPU.
